target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C A' B' C' : P) (r : ℝ), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → ¬Collinear ℝ ({A', B', C'} : Set P) → 0 < r → dist A B = r * dist A' B' → dist B C = r * dist B' C' → dist C A = r * dist C' A' → 1 / 2 * dist A B * dist B C * Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) = r ^ 2 * (1 / 2 * dist A' B' * dist B' C' * Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle A' B' C'))
